Kit summary

Final BlowBasicExclusive Lv.1
Deals DMG by 6% of Penny's Max HP and [HP Burning] DMG by 6% of Penny's Max HP to a single enemy, with a 100% chance to inflict [ATK Down II] on the target for 2 turns.
Giant Dragon Spirit Hammer Lv.1For every 1 ally with the [HP Burning] tag exists, increases all allies' [HP Burning] DMG dealt by 10%. After Penny pursues and attacks each time, increases 10% Turn Meter for self and the ally with the highest initial ATK. This effect can be triggered up to 3 times before Penny's next turn starts.
Hammer SwingActiveExclusive Lv.2
Deals 3 stages of [HP Burning] DMG by 5% of Penny's Max HP each to all enemies. The 3rd stage has a 100% chance to inflict [Cold II] on all enemies for 2 turns.
Giant Dragon Spirit Hammer Lv.2At the beginning of each wave and before Hammer Swing deals DMG, Penny grants [HP Burning UP II] to all allies for 2 turns. Giant Hammer Leap also removes all non-attribute buffs from all enemies.
Dragon Spirit ChasePassiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.3
This effect can only be triggered once during anyone's turn: Penny will cast Final Blow, Hammer Swing, or Giant Hammer Leap by turns to pursue and attack the main target once when other allies pursue and attack an enemy. Penny will cast Final Blow to pursue and attack when this effect is triggered for the first time in each wave. Penny additionally gains Effect Hit by 120% when she pursues and attacks. Increases Penny's DMG dealt to Boss to 200% of the original.
